finalText:
Read all 380 commits and 127 merged PRs. Draft is in `CHANGELOG.md` above 4.1.0.

Real content is small. One new feature, nine fix themes, three breaking changes. Everything else was deps, tests, CI, or moving files around.

Three things need your call:

| Item | Why I flagged it |
|---|---|
| `401` vs `403` for expired tokens | Shipped as a `fix`, but it changes an HTTP contract. I put it under Breaking. |
| Dropped v1 export route | Commit calls it "unused". Confirm no one still calls it. |
| Perf work | Four real speedups. Your three headings leave no room, so I left them out. |

Node 22 only touched CI and docs, never `engines`. So there's no version requirement to announce.
